facts.fact: Birr Metrics reports the National Bank of Ethiopia granted Safaricom a Payment Instrument Issuer licence in May 2023, and M-PESA launched on 16 August 2023.

ETH.note: Document states nothing on consumer protection rules or redress.
International remittances are mentioned with no named corridor or figure.
Document states nothing on government payments to people.
The 46 percent adult account figure names no survey and is dated only as 'at the time' of 2023.

facts.fact: Birr Metrics reports M-PESA Ethiopia, launched 16 August 2023, has 3.4 million 90-day active users and 12.3 billion birr in transactions over six months, and Telebirr has over 54.8 million users in FY2024/25.
Birr Metrics reports M-PESA's integration with EthSwitch gives interoperability with all connected banks and financial institutions.
Birr Metrics describes EthSwitch as Ethiopia's national payment network, through which M-PESA wallets make QR merchant payments with all connected banks.

ETH.note: Utility bill payments are mentioned, no tax or fee payment.
